content: Ceftriaxone for Injection, USP is a sterile, semisynthetic antibiotic belonging to the cephalosporin class, designed for administration either intravenously or intramuscularly. The active ingredient, ceftriaxone sodium, is chemically identified as (6R, 7R)-7-[2-(2-amino-4-thiazolyl)-2-methoxyiminoacetamido]-8-oxo-3-methyl-5-thia-1-azabicyclo[4.2.0]oct-2-ene-2-carboxylic acid, disodium salt, sesquaterhydrate. Its molecular formula is C18H16N8Na2O7S3·3.5H2O, and it has a molecular weight of 661.59. Ceftriaxone for Injection, USP appears as a white to yellowish-orange crystalline powder. It is highly soluble in water, moderately soluble in methanol, and minimally soluble in ethanol. When dissolved in water to create a 1% solution, the pH is approximately 6 to 7. The color of the prepared solution can vary from light yellow to amber, depending on factors such as storage duration, concentration, and the type of diluent used. Each Pharmacy Bulk Package of Ceftriaxone for Injection, USP is provided as a dry powder in vials. These vials contain sterile ceftriaxone sodium, USP, equivalent to 10 grams of ceftriaxone. This preparation is intended exclusively for intravenous infusion. Each gram of ceftriaxone activity contains approximately 83 mg (3.6 mEq) of sodium. The Pharmacy Bulk Package is a sterile container designed for parenteral use, containing multiple single doses. It is specifically intended for use in pharmacy admixture programs and is restricted to the preparation of intravenous infusion admixtures. It is important to note that further dilution of the product is required before administration. Detailed instructions for proper dilution and use can be found in the sections on Dosage and Administration and Directions for Proper Use of Pharmacy Bulk Package.
